steps.en: OCMS receives PLUS confirmation to overwrite the existing suspension
steps.id: OCMS menerima konfirmasi PLUS untuk menimpa suspension yang ada
steps.why_en: OCMS has no confirmation of its own; any later request with a new code is treated as the confirmation.
steps.why_id: OCMS tidak punya konfirmasi sendiri; permintaan berikutnya dengan kode baru dianggap sebagai konfirmasi.

steps.en: OCMS automatically revives the existing permanent suspension
steps.id: OCMS me-revive otomatis permanent suspension yang ada

steps.en: OCMS applies the new permanent suspension code to the notice
steps.id: OCMS menerapkan kode permanent suspension baru pada notice

steps.en: Earlier permanent suspension records are kept
steps.id: Catatan permanent suspension sebelumnya tetap disimpan

steps.en: OCMS tells PLUS the new suspension was applied
steps.id: OCMS memberi tahu PLUS bahwa suspension baru berhasil diterapkan
